description: This source file implements a 'pam' class with functions for initializing, prerequisites setup, parameter get/set, and system restart operations. It also includes external C functions for system configuration and management, and handles JSON-based request/response processing for system parameters and features like UPnP, DHCP, DNS, and system restart.

classes.name: pam
classes.description: A class providing system configuration, parameter management, and restart functions for system modules.
